Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 13
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Wikipedia infobox and incorrectly asserted that the place of death was Tempio Malatestiano (which is the burial site), instead of the actual death location shown in the infobox as Castel Sismondo (in Rimini). This conflation of burial site with place of death introduced a wrong, more specific location and led to oscillation and confusion in subsequent steps rather than resolving the discrepancy with proper source reconciliation.
